table 'All Dataflow Refresh History'
	lineageTag: 21808947-2213-40f3-803e-902463645ff2

	measure 'Dataflow Refresh Count' = COUNT('All Dataflow Refresh History'[Refresh ID])
		formatString: 0
		lineageTag: 4e6cd57f-a636-4715-8b41-2d001163c008

	measure 'Dataflow Refresh Count - Fail' =
			CALCULATE(
			    [Dataflow Refresh Count],
			    KEEPFILTERS(
			        'All Dataflow Refresh History'[Refresh Status] IN { "Failed" }
			    )
			)
		formatString: 0
		lineageTag: ed43efef-b385-49c0-b17e-ccf845614c5b

	measure 'Dataflow Refresh Count - Success' =
			CALCULATE(
			    [Dataflow Refresh Count],
			    KEEPFILTERS(
			        'All Dataflow Refresh History'[Refresh Status] IN { "Success" }
			    )
			)
		formatString: 0
		lineageTag: d06b21fb-a521-46ad-8973-8b5b91ee044d

	measure 'Dataflow Refresh Duration' =
			VAR Hours = INT([Dataflow Refresh Duration (Hours)])
			VAR Minutes = INT([Dataflow Refresh Duration (Minutes)])
			VAR Seconds = MOD([Dataflow Refresh Duration (Seconds)], 60)
			RETURN
			SWITCH(TRUE(), Seconds=blank(), BLANK(),  FORMAT(Hours, "00") & ":" & FORMAT(Minutes, "00") & ":" & FORMAT(Seconds, "00"))
		lineageTag: 32d3374d-3d50-4181-b631-c864c5bbde8d

	measure 'Dataflow Refresh Duration - Success' =
			CALCULATE(
			    [Dataflow Refresh Duration],
			    KEEPFILTERS(
			        'All Dataflow Refresh History'[Refresh Status] IN { "Success" }
			    )
			)
		lineageTag: f2762b7d-7290-452b-9764-e239d8856549

	measure 'Dataflow Refresh Duration (Hours - Success)' =
			CALCULATE(
			    [Dataflow Refresh Duration (Hours)],
			    KEEPFILTERS(
			        'All Dataflow Refresh History'[Refresh Status] IN { "Success" }
			    )
			)
		lineageTag: b569a4de-1e82-4ea7-98d5-2de5ce380803

	measure 'Dataflow Refresh Duration (Hours)' = DIVIDE([Dataflow Refresh Duration (Seconds)], 3600)
		lineageTag: 43ae6cf3-a506-4179-ae75-a4552bd54217

	measure 'Dataflow Refresh Duration (Minutes - Success)' =
			CALCULATE(
			    [Dataflow Refresh Duration (Minutes)],
			    KEEPFILTERS(
			        'All Dataflow Refresh History'[Refresh Status] IN { "Success" }
			    )
			)
		lineageTag: ea1909d1-08f4-49a8-b0cf-ba5c7bb54f8a

	measure 'Dataflow Refresh Duration (Minutes)' = DIVIDE([Dataflow Refresh Duration (Seconds)], 60)
		lineageTag: b421d920-3429-4e01-9fd8-2b3f83ecce39

	measure 'Dataflow Refresh Duration (Seconds - Success)' =
			CALCULATE(
			    [Dataflow Refresh Duration (Seconds)],
			    KEEPFILTERS(
			        'All Dataflow Refresh History'[Refresh Status] IN { "Success" }
			    )
			)
		formatString: 0
		lineageTag: 2ea795d5-71dc-42e2-881f-1b1cbc8fe377

	measure 'Dataflow Refresh Duration (Seconds)' = DATEDIFF([Dataflow Refresh Start Time], [Dataflow Refresh End Time], SECOND)
		formatString: 0
		lineageTag: d732b7a2-2a8b-4ab2-950f-f11fe331423c

	measure 'Dataflow Refresh Duration Average' = ```
			
			VAR TotalSeconds = [Dataflow Refresh Duration Average (Seconds - Success)]
			VAR Hours = INT(TotalSeconds / 3600)
			VAR Minutes = INT(MOD(TotalSeconds, 3600) / 60)
			VAR Seconds = MOD(TotalSeconds, 60)
			
			RETURN
			SWITCH(
			    TRUE(), 
			    ISBLANK(TotalSeconds), BLANK(), 
			    FORMAT(Hours, "00") & ":" & FORMAT(Minutes, "00") & ":" & FORMAT(Seconds, "00")
			)
			
			```
		lineageTag: 84fb5c4a-e558-45f3-8ba0-36efa80ad7a2

	measure 'Dataflow Refresh Duration Average (Hours - Success)' =
			DIVIDE(
			    [Dataflow Refresh Duration Total (Hours - Success)],
			    [Dataflow Refresh Count - Success]
			)
		formatString: 0
		lineageTag: f1634d80-8898-417d-be02-25e6215ec423

	measure 'Dataflow Refresh Duration Average (Minutes - Success)' =
			DIVIDE(
			    [Dataflow Refresh Duration Total (Minutes - Success)],

		lineageTag: c9fd40ef-5081-4f92-811e-dcd2265464ff

	measure 'Model Object Distinct Count - Table' =
			VAR SelectedFlag =
			    SELECTEDVALUE( 'Model Object Hierarchy'[Object Used Flag] )
			VAR TableFlagSummary =
			    ADDCOLUMNS(
			        SUMMARIZE(
			            'All Models',
			            'All Models'[Workspace Name - Model ID - Table Name]
			        ),
			        "HasUsed",
			            CALCULATE(
			                COUNTROWS( 'All Models' ),
			                'Model Object Hierarchy'[Object Used Flag] = "Used"
			            ),
			        "HasUnused",
			            CALCULATE(
			                COUNTROWS( 'All Models' ),
			                'Model Object Hierarchy'[Object Used Flag] = "Unused"
			            )
			    )
			VAR FilteredUsedOnly =
			    FILTER( TableFlagSummary, [HasUsed] > 0 )
			VAR FilteredUnusedOnly =
			    FILTER( TableFlagSummary, [HasUsed] = 0 && [HasUnused] > 0 )
			RETURN
			    SWITCH(
			        TRUE( ),
			        SelectedFlag = "Used", COUNTROWS( FilteredUsedOnly ),
			        SelectedFlag = "Unused", COUNTROWS( FilteredUnusedOnly ),
			        -- Fallback: no flag selected or multiple selected
			        DISTINCTCOUNTNOBLANK(
			            'All Models'[Workspace Name - Model ID - Table Name]
			        )
			    )
		formatString: #,0
		lineageTag: dde0e4c0-cb22-42b2-becf-51f8fda99721

	measure 'Report Object Weighted Usage Score' = ```
			VAR VisualFilters = [Filter Count - Visual Filters] * 0.5
			VAR Visuals = [Visual Distinct Count (Visual Impact)] * 1
			VAR Page = [Page Distinct Count (Visual Impact)] * 3
			VAR PageFilter = [Filter Count - Page Filters] * 4
			VAR Report = [Report Distinct Count (Visual Impact)] * 5
			VAR ReportFilter = [Filter Count - Report Filters] * 6
			VAR ModelsCount = [Model Distinct Count (Visual Impact)] * 8
			VAR Workspace = [Workspace Distinct Count (Visual Impact)] * 10
			VAR RptMeasures = [Report Objects Count - Measure] * 1
			VAR RptCol = [Report Objects Count - Column] * 0.75
			VAR RptAllElse = [Report Objects Count - All Else] * 0.5
			VAR RptObjectsAll = RptMeasures + RptCol + RptAllElse
			VAR HiddenPage = MAX('Report Hierarchy'[Page Hidden Flag])
			VAR InitialScore = 
			    ( VisualFilters + Visuals + Page + PageFilter + Report
			        + ReportFilter
			        + ModelsCount
			        + Workspace )
			        * RptObjectsAll
			VAR AdjustedScore = InitialScore * 0.6
			RETURN
			SWITCH(TRUE(), HiddenPage = "True", AdjustedScore, InitialScore)

	measure 'Visual Wireframe SVG' =
			VAR pageW = ROUND( AVERAGE( 'All Reports'[Page Width] ), 0 )
			VAR pageH = ROUND( AVERAGE( 'All Reports'[Page Height] ), 0 )
			VAR visualCategory =
			    SELECTEDVALUE( 'All Reports'[Visual Object Category] )
			
			/* ────────────── 1️⃣  Special case: Report / Page Filters ────────────── */
			VAR filterPaneSVG =
			    IF(
			        visualCategory IN { "Report Filters", "Page Filter" },
			        "<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 "
			            & pageW
			            & " "
			            & pageH
			            & "' preserveAspectRatio='xMidYMid meet' width='100%' height='100%'>"
			            & "<rect x='0' y='0' width='"
			            & pageW
			            & "' height='"
			            & pageH
			            & "' fill='#999999' />"
			            & "<text x='"
			            & ROUND( pageW / 2, 0 )
			            & "' y='"
			            & ROUND( pageH / 2, 0 )
			            & "' text-anchor='middle' dominant-baseline='middle' "
			            & "font-size='"
			            & MIN( 60, MAX( 20, ROUND( pageH * 0.08, 0 ) ) )
			            & "' font-family='Segoe UI' fill='white'>"
			            & IF(
			                visualCategory = "Report Filters",
			                "Report Filter -> Filter Pane",
			                "Page Filter -> Filter Pane"
			            )
			            & "</text></svg>",
			        BLANK( )
			    )
			VAR blankPaneSVG =
			    "<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 "
			        & pageW
			        & " "
			        & pageH
			        & "' preserveAspectRatio='xMidYMid meet' width='100%' height='100%'>"
			        & "<rect x='0' y='0' width='"
			        & pageW
			        & "' height='"
			        & pageH
			        & "' fill='#999999' />"
			        & "<text x='"
			        & ROUND( pageW / 2, 0 )
			        & "' y='"
			        & ROUND( pageH / 2, 0 )
			        & "' text-anchor='middle' dominant-baseline='middle' "
			        & "font-size='"
			        & MIN( 60, MAX( 20, ROUND( pageH * 0.08, 0 ) ) )
			        & "' font-family='Segoe UI' fill='white'>"
			        & "There is no visual wireframe"
			        & "</text></svg>"
			VAR blankPageselection =
			    "<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 1270 650' preserveAspectRatio='xMidYMid meet' width='100%' height='100%'>"
			        & "<rect x='0' y='0' width='1270' height='650' fill='#999999' />"
			        & "<text x='635' y='325' text-anchor='middle' dominant-baseline='middle' "
			        & "font-size='40' font-family='Segoe UI' fill='white'>"
			        & "Choose a Report and Page to view the Page Layout / Wireframe"
			        & "</text></svg>"
			
			/* ────────────── 2️⃣  Normal visuals (wireframe layout) ────────────── */
			VAR viewBox =
			    IF(
			        HASONEVALUE( 'All Reports'[Page Name] ),
			        "viewBox='0 0 " & pageW & " " & pageH
			            & "' preserveAspectRatio='xMidYMid meet' width='100%' height='100%'",
			        BLANK( )
			    )
			        & ">"
			VAR background =
			    "<rect x='0' y='0' width='" & pageW & "' height='" & pageH
			        & "' fill='#dbdbdb' stroke='black' stroke-width='0.2' vector-effect='non-scaling-stroke' />"
			VAR rectangles =
			    CONCATENATEX(
			        'All Reports',
			        VAR x = ROUND( 'All Reports'[Visual X Position], 0 )
			        VAR y = ROUND( 'All Reports'[Visual Y Position], 0 )
			        VAR w = ROUND( 'All Reports'[Visual Width], 0 )
			        VAR h = ROUND( 'All Reports'[Visual Height], 0 )
			        VAR cat =
			            SELECTEDVALUE( 'All Reports'[Visual Object Category] )
			        VAR fillColor =
			            IF( cat = "Visual Filters", "#E19490", "#A48CDA" )
			        VAR rect =
			            "<rect x='" & x & "' y='" & y & "' width='" & w
			                & "' height='"
			                & h
			                & "' fill='"
			                & fillColor
			                & "' stroke='black' stroke-width='0.2' vector-effect='non-scaling-stroke' />"
			
			        /* 🧠 Dynamically scale font size based on height, clamped to 10–60 */
			        VAR dynFont = MIN( 60, MAX( 10, ROUND( h * 0.40, 0 ) ) )
			        VAR label =
			            IF(
			                cat = "Visual Filters",
			                "<text x='" & ( x + w / 2 ) & "' y='" & ( y + h / 2 )
			                    & "' text-anchor='middle' dominant-baseline='middle' "
			                    & "font-size='"
			                    & dynFont
			                    & "' font-family='Segoe UI' fill='white'>Filter Pane</text>",
			                BLANK( )
			            )
			        RETURN
			            rect & label,
			        "",
			        'All Reports'[Visual Z Position]
			    )
			VAR svgWireframe =
			    IF(
			        LEN( rectangles ) > 0,
			        "<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' " & viewBox
			            & background
			            & rectangles
			            & "</svg>",
			        BLANK( )
			    )
			
			/* ────────────── 3️⃣  Final return ────────────── */
			VAR ReportObject = [Report Objects Count]
			VAR PageSelection =
			    SELECTEDVALUE( 'Report Hierarchy'[Page Name] )
			RETURN
			    SWITCH(
			        TRUE( ),
			        ISBLANK( PageSelection ), blankPageselection,
			        visualCategory IN { "Report Filters", "Page Filter" }, filterPaneSVG,
			        ISBLANK( pageW ), blankPaneSVG,
			        svgWireframe
			    )
		lineageTag: e59b4bc8-e55a-48fa-8e4f-294251a487b2

	measure 'Dependent Measures - All' =
			VAR SelectedMeasure =
			    SELECTEDVALUE(
			        'Measure Lineage - Dependents'[Measure Name]
			    )
			VAR ConcatenationResult =
			    CALCULATE(
			        CONCATENATEX(
			            DISTINCT(
			                FILTER(
			                    'Measure Lineage - Dependents',
			                    'Measure Lineage - Dependents'[Measure Name]
			                        = SelectedMeasure
			                )
			            ),
			            'Measure Lineage - Dependents'[Dependent Measure Name],
			            UNICHAR( 10 )   // This inserts a new line between each result
			        )
			    )
			RETURN
			    CALCULATE(
			        ConcatenationResult,
			        KEEPFILTERS(
			            'Measure Lineage - Dependents'[Dependent Measure Name]
			                <> BLANK( )
			        )
			    )

	measure 'Parent Measures - All' =
			VAR SelectedMeasure =
			    SELECTEDVALUE( 'Measure Lineage - Parents'[Measure Name] )
			VAR ConcatenationResult =
			    CALCULATE(
			        CONCATENATEX(
			            DISTINCT(
			                FILTER(
			                    'Measure Lineage - Parents',
			                    'Measure Lineage - Parents'[Measure Name] = SelectedMeasure
			                )
			            ),
			            'Measure Lineage - Parents'[Parent Measure Name],
			            UNICHAR( 10 )   // This inserts a new line between each result
			        )
			    )
			RETURN
			    CALCULATE(
			        ConcatenationResult,
			        KEEPFILTERS(
			            'Measure Lineage - Parents'[Parent Measure Name] <> BLANK( )
			        )
			    )
